sources.label: FNSPID — US semiconductors (2019–2020)
sources.description: Historical corpus from the FNSPID financial-news dataset, semiconductor slice covering the pre-Covid → Covid-shock → recovery arc. Static; does not update.

sources.label: FNSPID — Full corpus (our pipeline, updating)
sources.description: The complete FNSPID semiconductor corpus (54,563 articles, 2009–2024), built by our automated VM pipeline the correct way: qwen2.5:14b extraction → Judge LLM → third-LLM refinement, published chunk by chunk. Predictions appear once the rolling-window GAT trains on the finished refined corpus.

sources.label: FNSPID — Pierre’s run (2019–2021)
sources.description: Pierre’s standalone 2-year run: qwen2.5:14b extraction over 2019–2021 (5,358 articles), judged and third-LLM-refined, with predictions from his CE (No Edge Feats) GAT sweep winner (MRR 0.756).

sources.label: Project report (PDF)
sources.description: The full three-semester project report — data, pipeline, GAT, benchmarks, live corpus, factor model, and UI — as an in-app PDF.

sources.label: STOXX Europe 600 (Live)
sources.description: Curated 30-ticker STOXX Europe 600 subset with enriched extraction (sentiment / materiality / event type per triplet). Daily factor rollup + PCA + KMeans clustering. Refreshed every morning by the team GPU VM using local qwen2.5:14b — zero API cost.
